Plugin.Name: Thunderbolt Net
Plugin.Overview: Reliable single-link host-to-host networking over Thunderbolt/USB4 on Unraid. Fabric overview, trained rate and lanes, per-link settings (tbn0/tbn1…), services on TB IPs, known peers, harden, and activity. One cable, one peer, eth-like UX — not dual-cable bonding or a promise of sticker 40 Gb/s dual-lane.
